data.action: 趴在窗台上看雨滴滑落
data.description: 雨声淅沥的午后，苏茜双手托腮趴在理发店的玻璃窗台前，出神地看着雨滴顺着明亮的玻璃滑落。她头顶的小猫耳随着雨声轻轻转动——「下雨天的时候店里总是很安静呢……博士，要不要我帮你做一次免费的头部精油按摩放松一下？」
data.promptProse: She rests her chin in both hands on the broad salon windowsill, following a raindrop down the glass; soft grey daylight falls across her face as her tail sways.
data.title: 澄闪 · 雨窗
data.animaCaption: Her chin rests in both hands as she follows a raindrop down the salon window.
